blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – A police corporal assigned to the Mandaue City Police Office (MCPO) is facing criminal and administrative cases over an alleged assault on a 22-year-old civilian in Minglanilla, Cebu, with possible penalties including imprisonment and suspension from service. The 30-year-old police officer is facing a criminal complaint for physical injuries after allegedly punching the civilian during a confrontation along the National Highway in Barangay Poblacion Ward II, Minglanilla, on November 12, 2026. An investigation conducted by the Minglanilla police found that the corporal allegedly threw the first punch, hitting the victim on the right jaw. CCTV footage and […]...
